subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this stay as the distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery issue, or be folded into broader ambiguous-send recovery work?
rationale: The source path confirms a Telegram ambiguous-send recovery gap, but the report adds reasoning-preview/final delivery and Control UI history pressure that the existing related issues and PRs do not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place to prove the reasoning preview/final path and decide whether `chat.history` needs debouncing or backpressure.

options.title: Fold Into Ambiguous-Send Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms, and move remaining recovery work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 plus the overlapping recovery PRs.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate canonical item for the `chat.history` latency burst if maintainers want separate ownership.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place to prove the reasoning preview/final path and decide whether `chat.history` needs debouncing or backpressure.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent outbound recovery history makes this the best available owner for the unknown-send reconciliation decision, with Telegram streaming owners needed for implementation review.
